title: Cannell Peter B & Co. Inc. Trims Position in Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Cannell Peter B & Co. Inc. lessened its stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.6% in the 2nd its most recent disclosure with the SEC. The firm owned 401,526 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 10,616 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 2.8% of Cannell Peter B & Co. Inc.’s investment portfolio, making the stock its 4th biggest holding. Cannell Peter B & Co. Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $74,326,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
